judgments.yea_description: Voted to send H.J.Res. 20 to the President, using the Congressional Review Act to repeal the Department of Energy efficiency standards for consumer gas-fired instantaneous water heaters. It passed the Senate 53-44.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against sending H.J.Res. 20 to the President, which used the Congressional Review Act to repeal the Department of Energy efficiency standards for consumer gas-fired instantaneous water heaters. It passed the Senate 53-44.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass S. 146, the TAKE IT DOWN Act, which made it a federal crime to publish nonconsensual intimate images, including computer-generated deepfakes, and required online platforms to remove them within 48 hours of a valid request. It passed the House 409-2 and was signed into law.
judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing S. 146, the TAKE IT DOWN Act, which made it a federal crime to publish nonconsensual intimate images, including computer-generated deepfakes, and required online platforms to remove them within 48 hours of a valid request. It passed the House 409-2 and was signed into law.

judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass S.J.Res. 49, which would have terminated the national emergency the President declared on April 2, 2025 to impose a 10 percent tariff on most imports and higher duties on specified trading partners. It failed in the Senate on a 49-49 tie.

judgments.nay_description: Voted against passing H.J.Res. 78, which used the Congressional Review Act to repeal the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service rule listing the San Francisco Bay-Delta longfin smelt as endangered, removing the fish's Endangered Species Act protection. It passed the House 216-195.
